name: update_full_row_versioned
comment: The full-row UPDATE of a versioned entity (Transaction): every non-key, non-version, non-generated column, version = version + 1, the version required in the WHERE; on SQL Server the batch reports its own count (ADR-0040 add.3).

expect.sqlite: update transactions set user_id = @user_id, status = @status, amount = @amount, note = @note, created_at = @created_at, updated_at = @updated_at, version = version + 1 where id = @id and version = @version
expect.sqlserver: set nocount on; update [transactions] set [user_id] = @user_id, [status] = @status, [amount] = @amount, [note] = @note, [created_at] = @created_at, [updated_at] = @updated_at, [version] = [version] + 1 where [id] = @id and [version] = @version; select @@rowcount; set nocount off
